messages.author: e839611f540e7694
messages.subject: New error since 11.3.2020 update: Condition 'cond2' does not match the set names from "snames" argument.
parts:
Hey all,
This is my first time posting an error, so apologies if I miss anything out.
I have noticed this error since the most recent update of the 'QCA' R package: 
Error: Condition 'cond2' does not match the set names from "snames" argument.
An error of this sort occurred despite the code used working a week previously and despite being tested using two different datasets.
I have provided attached a minimum workable example.
Any help would be much appreciated.
Thanks,
Jen

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Re: New error since 11.3.2020 update: Condition 'cond2' does not match the set names from "snames" argument.
parts:
Dear Jen,

I need to make sure you have the right versions of the packages, the CRAN mirror is very fresh and it is possible that binaries are not yet available for all operating systems.
By the way, which OS are you using?

Could you please post the result of this R command:
> print(sessionInfo())

Best,
Adrian

Dear Alicia,

It would be good to have a minimal reproducible example, but I think I already know what this is all about, and this is fixed for the upcoming version of the QCA package.

If I am not mistaken, you are using a dataset with more than 26 columns. For the moment, try to stick to at most 26 columns and it will work, this being a temporary limitation until the new version of the package will be released.

Best,
Adrian

On Thursday, April 30, 2020 at 4:57:08 PM UTC+10, Adrian Dușa wrote:

Dear Alicia,

It would be good to have a minimal reproducible example, but I think I already know what this is all about, and this is fixed for the upcoming version of the QCA package.

If I am not mistaken, you are using a dataset with more than 26 columns. For the moment, try to stick to at most 26 columns and it will work, this being a temporary limitation until the new version of the package will be released.

Best,
Adrian
